liebermann.description_de: British Museum Cotton Claudius A III
liebermann.shelfmark_as_given: London, British Library, Cotton MS Claudius A.iii, f. 17–27b (Kb)
liebermann.date: K: f. 7–17 c. 1010; Kb: f. 17–27b early 12th century; f. 28/30 ff. early 11th century; pontifical late 11th century
liebermann.notes: Fragments of several liturgical MSS: a Canterbury cathedral gospel book with Old English charters and papal letters for Canterbury; a pontifical fragment of c. 1010 (ff. 7–17) with Dunstan's portrait and the Consecratio regis with Sacr cor; Kb (ff. 17–27v, early 12th c.) another Consecratio regis, headed 'Henrici I' in the 16th century, with Sacr cor; and an early-11th-century volume with the poem 'Ic eom halgungboc' for Thored, the Latin paraphrase of VI Atr and the Old English VI Atr, further pontificals and a benedictional.
